rust_summary: hiding a player from the players below a permission level (`native_hide_player`).
doc_summary: hiding a player (a vanish): `native_hide_player(uuid, level)` hides that player, from the next tick, from the players below permission `level` (None shows them again): they leave those players' Tab list and world (their clients stop tracking them, as they do a spectator) and those players don't read them joining or leaving. Players of `level` or more still see them; a player made an operator sees them again. It is kept by UUID, for a player who is off too, until a mod sets it again or the server stops. Server only; false on a client. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hide_player@.
